description: Address code review findings: missing filter bar CSS, init race condition, weak source_id hash, XSS in showResult, duplicated report logic, and N+1 query comment.
steps: Step 1: Add CSS styles for .reports-filter-bar and .filter-select to src/renderer/css/reports.css
Step 2: Make init() async and await applyStoredLanguage() before navigate('dashboard') in src/renderer/js/app.js
Step 3: Replace DJB hash in src/services/export-bundle.js with crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')
Step 4: Escape result.message using escapeHtml() in import-export.js showResult()
Step 5: Factor out shared student-summary-building logic in src/services/reports.js into a helper function
Step 6: Add a comment noting the N+1 serial loop is acceptable for typical 5 levels in reports.js renderer
acceptance_criteria: Filter bar renders with proper layout in reports screen
Language is applied before first navigation occurs
Source ID uses cryptographically random bytes instead of DJB hash
Error messages are HTML-escaped before innerHTML injection
Shared report logic is factored into a helper function
verification: Run npx jest --no-coverage and confirm all 136 tests pass
